newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished little changed on Wednesday on bank caution ahead of Thursday's National Day holiday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 4.804 against Tuesday's 4.846 end, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 4.70-4.75.
The central bank issued T$10 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit to ease liquidity today.
The bond market reported listless trade ahead of the holiday. The money and bond markets will close on Thursday.
